svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Expected years of schooling among men and women in tertiary education
For each year, this shows how many years a child starting school then can expect to spend in tertiary education
if current enrollment patterns stay the same. It includes repeated grades.
